Name: Golden Coconut Tree
Author: Gervig91
Description:
[size=6][b][u]Golden Coconut Tree

[/u][/b][/size][size=3]Adds a new quest to the special orders boards once Ginger Island has been unlocked. The Wizard wants to research the rumors of the mysterious Golden Coconut!

[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/f4UdVw1.png[/img] ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿[img]https://i.imgur.com/f4UdVw1.png[/img] ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿[img]https://i.imgur.com/f4UdVw1.png[/img][/center][/size][size=5][b][u]Spoilers
[/u][/b][/size][size=3][spoiler]- Pick up the quest at the mission board. You will need to have unlocked Ginger Island.
- Collect 5 Golden Coconut and deliver them to the Wizard.
- The next morning the Wizard will send you a letter with a Golden Palm Tree Sapling. This will produce Golden Coconuts in the Summer or year round on the Ginger Island farm.[/spoiler][/size]

[u][size=5][b]Installation[/b][/size][/u]
[size=3]Make sure to have the latest versions of the required mods:[/size]
[size=3] ﻿- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url][/size]
[size=3] ﻿- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿
[/size]
[size=3]Drop the mod into your Stardew Valley mods folder, load up the game. Enjoy :)[/size]

[size=3][center][img]https://i.imgur.com/qCHlWLi.png[/img][/center][/size][size=5][b][u]Configuration
[/u][/b][/size][size=3]1.1 Adds a config for difficulty settings:
- [b]Easy[/b]: Collect / deliver [b]1[/b] Golden Coconut.
- [b]Medium[/b]: Collect / deliver [b]5[/b] Golden Coconuts. (Default setting)
- [b]Hard[/b]: Collect / deliver [b]10[/b] Golden Coconuts.
- [b]Hell[/b]: Collect / deliver [b]20[/b] Golden Coconuts.

[/size][size=5][b][u]Extra
[/u][/b][/size][size=3]The quest is unique and can only be obtained once. Therefor I highly recommend using the [/size][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2594][size=3]Crop Transplant Mod[/size][/url][size=3] if you want to move the tree after having planted it, since you can only get the 1. I also highly recommend planting the tree on your Ginger Island farm or Greenhouse for maximum profit ;)[/size]
